== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Oracle]] [[Sage]], also known as the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]], is a battle-hardened combatant characterized by numerous eyes that glow with the intensity of a sunrise. A formidable opponent, she possesses the ability to provide guidance to forces, such as those of [[House Shen]], though she struggles in direct physical confrontations where standard Archlord{{!}}Archlords can hold their own. In combat, she wields a large two-handed [[sword]] and demonstrates the ability to perceive various potential futures. Beyond her martial capabilities, she acts as a guide and Authority{{!}}authority figure, offering blessings, commands, and strategic warnings to others regarding their survival and the consequences of their actions.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Oracle]] [[Sage]] serves as a director of forces for Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius. They do not participate in direct combat.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]], this individual provides sight that enables [[Mercy]] to see targets highlighted in purple light.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes]], the Oracle [[Sage]] is one of the individuals present during these events. Rather than engaging directly in battle, the entity focuses on directing forces for Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius. During the conflict, the Oracle [[Sage]] provides specialized sight that enables [[Mercy]] to see a target highlighted in purple light.}}
